scenes.title: Who owns the shared future?
scenes.viewerPurpose: Offer autonomous firms sharing a trusted brand as the specific proposal; Name the shared-rules proposal and retained autonomy
scenes.composition: Show two separate workshops placing the same trusted name beside their own doors. Place a shared charter between the workshops while each keeps its own tools, work and decisions.

scenes.title: A name becomes a promise
scenes.viewerPurpose: Give shared branding a promise that members and customers can invoke; Distinguish shared reputation from becoming one corporation
scenes.composition: Let a customer point to a promise on the shared charter and a member listen. Move between the shared name and the two independent workplaces without merging their buildings.

scenes.title: The powers behind participation
scenes.viewerPurpose: Expose the contested powers a shared identity must settle; Trace those powers into resources, records and meaningful exit
scenes.composition: Place proposed rule change, membership decision and sale request before more than one member. Keep the shared record, common resources and usable separate exit route visible together.

scenes.title: Follow the common name
scenes.viewerPurpose: Set the proposal against both ownership concentration and superficial sharing; Invite scrutiny of the members' actual decision rights
scenes.composition: Contrast a single owner's control with a membership discussion where the shared charter actually constrains decisions. End on the charter between the workshops, with members still able to choose their own work.
